immutable_ref_rules.repo_local: the recorded base commit/tree and Git blobs; untracked target artifacts are nonrelease worker evidence
immutable_ref_rules.mathlib: the existing lake-manifest commit/package tree and clean package worktree; no dependency mutation
immutable_ref_rules.external: a candidate receives source credit only after resolution to a 40-hex commit and source digest; search hits alone receive no proof credit
immutable_ref_rules.human_sources: DOI, edition, and catalog identity are metadata anchors; no theorem-text or H0 credit without an immutable scan and premise crosswalk
immutable_ref_rules.search_responses: dated response hashes bind the bounded observation only and are not immutable proof-source or saturation evidence

credentials_policy: Unauthenticated public endpoints only. Missing login, HTTP denial, rate limiting, timeout, or access challenge is an explicit access failure, never a negative result.
expected_negative_evidence: Record every bounded query family, completion/truncation state, count, response or result-list SHA-256 when retained, and any access limitation. A zero result never proves global nonexistence.
classification_policy: Compare each candidate to the literal frozen Lean expression, not the comments' intended mathematics. Substrate, statement shapes, and stronger-premise lemmas are M3/E3 at best. M1 requires immutable independently reproducible kernel closure; M0 requires repo-local exact integration and accepted trust evidence. Placeholder-bearing or statement-mismatched candidates are M5.
credit_boundary: This protocol governs a bounded formal-anchor and source-metadata audit only. It cannot supply H0, a Kodaira proof, M1/M0, AUDIT-Z, theorem completion, release, or master acceptance.
